'''Portent''' was an undercover [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] agent for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], who helped facilitate [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] forces into [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
